mode: built-in image_gen, one edit per original design
prompt_template: Edit this existing nametag asset into a pure black-and-white version for a monochrome e-ink display. Preserve exact text "Jeff BigTaro", the distinctive lettering of this particular design, overall layout, clean white background, wide 20:7 aspect ratio, and generous outer margins. No red, gray, gradients, halftone, shadows in gray, texture, mockup, or extra text. Use only solid #000000 black and #FFFFFF white. Change red decorative circuit lines and exterior accents to black; where red details sit inside black lettering, use crisp white cutouts so the details remain visible. Keep lettering readable and all artwork inside the canvas. This is design {n} of three; preserve this specific reference design rather than inventing a different logo. Output 960 by 336 pixels if supported.
device_format: 960x336, 1-bit grayscale PNG, no dithering; resized and thresholded by the build script
